public_result.guidance:
Qualifying costs, components, depreciation, disposals and CIP reconcile to gross ledgers.
Qualifying ordinary machinery costs are capitalized under the cost model. Depreciation starts when ready for use; the depreciable carrying amount excludes residual value and is allocated over the supported remaining life or production units.

citations.title: Accounts payable governed knowledge package — background guidance

public_result.guidance:
Supplier invoices, payments and independently received unbilled liabilities reconciled.
Recognize supplier obligations for goods or services received by period end. Measure supported unbilled receipts using evidenced quantities and rates, avoid duplicate invoice accruals, and reconcile payments and supplier balances to the ledger.
